# Edit operations

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-skill-reference.ts from src/core/operation-dispatch.ts. Do not edit by hand. -->

Send them to `POST /api/agent/operations` as `{ "projectPath": "…", "operations": [ { "op": "…", … }, … ], "dryRun"?: true }`.
They run in order; the batch is atomic (a malformed operation or an invalid result saves nothing).
Each result is `{ index, op, applied, detail?, createdId?, createdIds? }` — `applied: false` means valid but nothing changed (see `detail`).
Unknown parameters are rejected, so a typo is reported instead of silently ignored.
2D-map operations work in grid cells; 3D-map operations in meters (x east, z south, y up). Using one kind on the other kind of map is rejected with a hint.

# 2D maps (tile grid)

## placeObject

Places an object with its top-left at (x, y), replacing anything its footprint overlaps on that layer.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `objectId` | string | yes | Id of an object in the project catalog. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Id of a layer of that map. |
| `x` | integer | yes | Grid column (0-based). For multi-cell objects, any cell of the footprint works for lookups; placement uses it as the top-left. |
| `y` | integer | yes | Grid row (0-based). |
| `spriteId` | string | no | One of the object's sprite ids; omit to show the object's default sprite. |

## removeObject

Removes the instance covering cell (x, y) on a layer (any cell of a multi-cell object's footprint).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Id of a layer of that map. |
| `x` | integer | yes | Grid column (0-based). For multi-cell objects, any cell of the footprint works for lookups; placement uses it as the top-left. |
| `y` | integer | yes | Grid row (0-based). |

## moveObject

Moves the instance covering (x, y) so its top-left lands on (toX, toY), replacing what it overlaps there.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Id of a layer of that map. |
| `x` | integer | yes | Grid column (0-based). For multi-cell objects, any cell of the footprint works for lookups; placement uses it as the top-left. |
| `y` | integer | yes | Grid row (0-based). |
| `toX` | integer | yes | Destination column of the top-left cell. |
| `toY` | integer | yes | Destination row of the top-left cell. |

## fillArea

Flood-fills the connected region around (x, y) (cells holding the same object, or empty) with a 1x1 object.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `objectId` | string | yes | Id of an object in the project catalog. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Id of a layer of that map. |
| `x` | integer | yes | Grid column (0-based). For multi-cell objects, any cell of the footprint works for lookups; placement uses it as the top-left. |
| `y` | integer | yes | Grid row (0-based). |

## fillRect

Paints a rectangle of cells with an object (roads, walls, lakes…), tiling multi-cell objects by their footprint.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `objectId` | string | yes | Id of an object in the project catalog. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Id of a layer of that map. |
| `x` | integer | yes | Grid column (0-based). For multi-cell objects, any cell of the footprint works for lookups; placement uses it as the top-left. |
| `y` | integer | yes | Grid row (0-based). |
| `width` | integer | yes | Rectangle width in cells. |
| `height` | integer | yes | Rectangle height in cells. |
| `spriteId` | string | no | One of the object's sprite ids; omit to show the object's default sprite. |

## removeInstances

Removes several instances at once.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `targets` | array | yes | Array of { layerId, x, y }, each identifying an instance by any cell it covers. |

## duplicateInstance

Copies the instance covering (x, y) into the nearest free spot next to it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Id of a layer of that map. |
| `x` | integer | yes | Grid column (0-based). For multi-cell objects, any cell of the footprint works for lookups; placement uses it as the top-left. |
| `y` | integer | yes | Grid row (0-based). |

## setInstanceSprite

Chooses which of its object's sprites an instance shows (null = follow the object's default).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |

# Layers (2D and 3D maps)

## createLayer

Adds a layer on top of a map's existing layers.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `name` | string | yes | Display name. |
| `id` | string | no | Layer id; derived from the name if omitted. |

Deletes a layer and every instance on it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Id of a layer of that map. |

Moves a layer to another index (0 = drawn first / bottom).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Id of a layer of that map. |
| `toIndex` | integer | yes | New index, clamped to the valid range. |

Renames, shows/hides, or locks/unlocks a layer.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Id of a layer of that map. |
| `name` | string | no | New layer name. |
| `visible` | boolean | no | Whether the layer is drawn. |
| `locked` | boolean | no | Locked layers reject every edit. |

# Maps

## createMap

Adds a map. kind "2d" (default): a tile grid with one empty "ground" layer. kind "3d": a flat terrain (heightmap + up to 4 painted texture layers) with one "objects" layer. The object catalog is shared by all maps.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Display name. |
| `kind` | string | no | "2d" (default) or "3d". |
| `width` | number | yes | 2D: width in cells (integer). 3D: terrain width in meters (x axis). |
| `height` | integer | no | 2D only (required): height in cells. |
| `depth` | number | no | 3D only: terrain depth in meters (z axis); defaults to width. |
| `resolution` | integer | no | 3D only: heightmap samples per side, 17-513 (default 129). More = finer sculpting, bigger file. A power of two plus one keeps samples on round coordinates. |
| `baseHeight` | number | no | 3D only: starting height of the flat terrain in meters (default 0). |
| `waterLevel` | number|null | no | 3D only: height of a water plane in meters, or null for none (default). |
| `terrainLayers` | array | no | 3D only: 1-4 texture layers { id?, name, color: "#rrggbb", texture?, tileSize? } — the first covers the whole terrain. Default: grass, rock, sand, snow (plain colors). |
| `tileWidth` | integer | no | 2D only: cell width in pixels (default 32). |
| `tileHeight` | integer | no | 2D only: cell height in pixels (default 32). |
| `id` | string | no | Map id; derived from the name if omitted. |

## removeMap

Deletes a map (the last remaining map can't be deleted).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |

## renameMap

Renames a map.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `name` | string | yes | Display name. |

## resizeMap

Resizes a 2D map; instances whose footprint no longer fits are removed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `width` | integer | yes | New width in cells. |
| `height` | integer | yes | New height in cells. |

# Object catalog (shared by every map)

## addObjectDefinition

Adds an object to the shared catalog. kind "2d" (default): drawn from sprites — tiles on 2D maps, upright billboards on 3D maps; without sprites it's invisible (spawn point, trigger, invisible wall…). kind "3d": a .glb model, 3D maps only; without a model it's an invisible 3D marker.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Display name. |
| `kind` | string | no | "2d" (default) or "3d". Fixed once created. |
| `id` | string | no | Object id; derived from the name if omitted. |
| `description` | string | no | Free-text notes (e.g. gameplay meaning). |
| `sizeInTiles` | object | no | { width, height } footprint in cells; default 1x1. On 3D maps a 2D object's billboard is 1 m per tile. |
| `sprites` | array | no | 2D objects only. Array of { id?, name?, image, collisions? }. `image` is an asset path inside the project ("assets/x.png"). Collision shapes are in the sprite image's pixels, centered on x/y: { type: "rect", x, y, width, height, rotation? } \| { type: "circle", x, y, radius } \| { type: "triangle", x, y, points: [{x,y},{x,y},{x,y}] (offsets from the center), rotation? }. Rotation is in degrees, clockwise. |
| `defaultSpriteId` | string | no | 2D objects: sprite shown by default; defaults to the first sprite. |
| `collisions` | array | no | Collision shapes for a sprite-less object (spawn point, trigger, invisible wall), in footprint space: 32 px per tile, origin at the footprint's top-left. Same shape format as sprite collisions. |
| `model` | string | no | 3D objects only: a .glb model inside the project ("assets/tree.glb"), uploaded first with POST /api/agent/assets. |

## updateObjectDefinition

Changes a catalog object (its kind can't change). Given fields replace the old ones; instances using removed sprites fall back to the default.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `objectId` | string | yes | Id of an object in the project catalog. |
| `name` | string | no | New name. |
| `description` | string | no | New notes ("" clears them). |
| `sizeInTiles` | object|null | no | { width, height }, or null for 1x1. |
| `sprites` | array | no | 2D objects: replaces all sprites (empty = sprite-less object). Array of { id?, name?, image, collisions? }. `image` is an asset path inside the project ("assets/x.png"). Collision shapes are in the sprite image's pixels, centered on x/y: { type: "rect", x, y, width, height, rotation? } \| { type: "circle", x, y, radius } \| { type: "triangle", x, y, points: [{x,y},{x,y},{x,y}] (offsets from the center), rotation? }. Rotation is in degrees, clockwise. |
| `defaultSpriteId` | string | no | Which sprite is the default. |
| `collisions` | array | no | Replaces the object-level collisions. Collision shapes for a sprite-less object (spawn point, trigger, invisible wall), in footprint space: 32 px per tile, origin at the footprint's top-left. Same shape format as sprite collisions. |
| `model` | string|null | no | 3D objects: a new .glb model, or null for an invisible marker. |

## duplicateObjectDefinition

Copies a catalog object (sprites and collisions included) under a new id.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `objectId` | string | yes | Id of an object in the project catalog. |
| `newId` | string | no | Id of the copy; derived if omitted. |
| `newName` | string | no | Name of the copy; defaults to "<name> copy". |

## removeObjectDefinition

Deletes a catalog object and every instance of it in every map.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `objectId` | string | yes | Id of an object in the project catalog. |

## renameProject

Renames the project.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `name` | string | yes | Display name. |

# 3D maps: terrain

## sculptTerrain

Sculpts the terrain with a round brush at (x, z) — or along a stroke to (toX, toZ): raise (hills, ridges), lower (valleys, riverbeds), smooth (soften), flatten (level toward `height`).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `mode` | string | yes | "raise", "lower", "smooth" or "flatten". |
| `x` | number | yes | World x in meters, 0 to the terrain width. |
| `z` | number | yes | World z in meters, 0 to the terrain depth. |
| `toX` | number | no | Stroke end x (meters). Omit for a single dab. |
| `toZ` | number | no | Stroke end z (meters). |
| `radius` | number | yes | Brush radius in meters (smooth falloff to the edge). |
| `strength` | number | yes | raise/lower: meters at the center. smooth/flatten: 0-1 blend. |
| `height` | number | no | flatten: target height in meters (default: height at x, z). |

## paintTerrain

Paints a terrain texture layer with a round brush at (x, z) — or along a stroke to (toX, toZ): paths, beaches, rocky patches.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Id of a terrain texture layer of that map (see terrain.layers). |
| `x` | number | yes | World x in meters, 0 to the terrain width. |
| `z` | number | yes | World z in meters, 0 to the terrain depth. |
| `toX` | number | no | Stroke end x (meters). |
| `toZ` | number | no | Stroke end z (meters). |
| `radius` | number | yes | Brush radius in meters. |
| `strength` | number | yes | 0-1: how fully the layer covers at the brush center (1 = replace). |

## generateTerrain

Generates natural relief with fractal noise (deterministic for a seed). Use island: true with a waterLevel for islands. Follow with autoPaintTerrain to texture it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `seed` | integer | no | Random seed (default 1). |
| `amplitude` | number | no | Height range of the relief in meters (default 12). |
| `featureSize` | number | no | Typical size of hills in meters (default 40). Larger = broader shapes. |
| `octaves` | integer | no | Detail levels 1-8 (default 5). Higher = more rugged. |
| `baseHeight` | number | no | Height added everywhere (default 0). |
| `mode` | string | no | "replace" (default) or "add" on top of the current relief. |
| `island` | boolean | no | Sink the edges below 0 so the land forms an island (default false). |

## setTerrainHeightRect

Sets a world rectangle to one height — a flat plot for buildings, a plateau, a pit. Smooth the edges afterwards with sculptTerrain mode smooth.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `x` | number | yes | Rectangle min x (meters). |
| `z` | number | yes | Rectangle min z (meters). |
| `width` | number | yes | Size along x (meters). |
| `depth` | number | yes | Size along z (meters). |
| `height` | number | yes | Target height (meters). |

## autoPaintTerrain

Textures the whole terrain from rules on height and slope; for each point the first matching rule wins, e.g. [{layerId:'sand',maxHeight:1},{layerId:'rock',minSlope:35},{layerId:'snow',minHeight:20},{layerId:'grass'}].

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `rules` | array | yes | Array of { layerId, minHeight?, maxHeight?, minSlope?, maxSlope? } (meters, degrees). Points matching no rule keep their paint. |
| `blend` | boolean | no | Soften the borders between layers (default true). |

## setWaterLevel

Adds, moves or removes (null) the sea: a flat water plane covering every part of the terrain lower than `level`. For lakes at other heights (mountain lakes, ponds), use addWaterBody.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `level` | number|null | yes | Water height in meters, or null for no water. |

## addTerrainLayer

Adds a texture layer to a terrain (at most 4). Paint it with paintTerrain or autoPaintTerrain.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `name` | string | yes | Display name. |
| `id` | string | no | Layer id; derived from the name if omitted. |
| `color` | string | yes | Average color "#rrggbb" (used when there's no texture, and in previews). |
| `texture` | string | no | A tiling image inside the project ("assets/grass.png"). |
| `tileSize` | number | no | Meters covered by one repetition of the texture (default 4). |

## updateTerrainLayer

Changes a terrain texture layer's name, color, texture or tiling.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Terrain layer id. |
| `name` | string | no | New name. |
| `color` | string | no | "#rrggbb". |
| `texture` | string|null | no | A tiling image inside the project, or null to use the plain color. |
| `tileSize` | number | no | Meters per texture repetition. |

## removeTerrainLayer

Removes a terrain texture layer; where it was painted, the remaining layers take over. The last layer can't be removed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Terrain layer id. |

## addDetailLayer

Adds a detail layer (like Unity's "Paint Details"): grass, flowers or small bushes painted as a density, not placed one by one — a whole meadow stays light. Without sprite/model it's procedural grass blades in `color`. At most 4 per map. Then fill it with autoPaintDetails or paintDetails.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `name` | string | yes | Display name. |
| `id` | string | no | Layer id; derived from the name if omitted. |
| `color` | string | no | Blade color / tint "#rrggbb" (default "#6b9a3c"). |
| `sprite` | string | no | A tuft image (transparent PNG, "assets/grass-tuft.png"), drawn as two crossed quads. |
| `model` | string | no | Or a small .glb (flower, bush), scaled to `height`. |
| `width` | number | no | Tuft width in meters (default 0.5). |
| `height` | number | no | Tuft height in meters (default 0.45). |
| `sizeVariation` | number | no | 0-1 random size variation (default 0.35). |
| `density` | number | no | Tufts per m² at 100% painted density (default 6; flowers 0.5-1, bushes 0.05-0.2). |

## updateDetailLayer

Changes a detail layer's look (color, sprite, model, size, variation) or its tufts per m².

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Detail layer id. |
| `name` | string | no | New name. |
| `color` | string | no | "#rrggbb". |
| `sprite` | string|null | no | Tuft image, or null for procedural blades. |
| `model` | string|null | no | .glb model, or null. |
| `width` | number | no | Meters. |
| `height` | number | no | Meters. |
| `sizeVariation` | number | no | 0-1. |
| `density` | number | no | Tufts per m² at 100%. |

## removeDetailLayer

Removes a detail layer and its painted density.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Detail layer id. |

## paintDetails

Paints (or erases) grass/flower density with a round brush at (x, z), or along a stroke to (toX, toZ) — e.g. erase grass along a path.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Detail layer id. |
| `x` | number | yes | World x in meters, 0 to the terrain width. |
| `z` | number | yes | World z in meters, 0 to the terrain depth. |
| `toX` | number | no | Stroke end x. |
| `toZ` | number | no | Stroke end z. |
| `radius` | number | yes | Brush radius (meters). |
| `strength` | number | yes | 0-1: 1 = full density (or none with erase) at the center. |
| `erase` | boolean | no | Remove instead of add. |

## autoPaintDetails

Fills a whole detail layer from rules: where a terrain texture dominates, between heights, below a slope, out of water, with natural clumps (patchiness). Replaces what was painted on that layer; density 0 clears it.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Detail layer id. |
| `density` | number | no | 0-1 painted density where the rules match (default 1). |
| `onTerrainLayerId` | string | no | Only where this terrain texture layer dominates (e.g. "grass"). |
| `minHeight` | number | no | Meters. |
| `maxHeight` | number | no | Meters. |
| `maxSlope` | number | no | Degrees. |
| `patchiness` | number | no | 0-1: clumps and clearings instead of a uniform carpet (0.4 looks natural). |
| `patchSize` | number | no | Clump size in meters (default 12). |
| `seed` | integer | no | Random seed for the clumps. |
| `avoidWater` | boolean | no | No grass in the sea or lakes (default true). |

## addWaterBody

Adds a lake/pond at its own height, anywhere (even high in the mountains): water poured at (x, z) fills the connected basin up to `level`. Dig the basin first (sculptTerrain lower) so the water has banks, then use fill: true to fill it exactly to the brim. A level above the lowest bank overflows as far as the terrain lets it (unless `area` limits it). Independent of the sea (setWaterLevel).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `x` | number | yes | Seed x (meters): a low spot inside the basin. |
| `z` | number | yes | Seed z (meters). |
| `level` | number | no | Water surface height (meters). Default: 1.5 m above the ground at the seed. |
| `depth` | number | no | Alternative to level: surface height above the ground at the seed (meters). |
| `fill` | boolean | no | Fill the hollow to the brim: the highest level before the water would overflow its lowest bank (recommended — no guessing, no leaks). Ignores level/depth. |
| `name` | string | no | Display name (default "Lake"). |
| `color` | string | no | Tint "#rrggbb" (default water blue). |
| `area` | object | no | { x, z, width, depth }: world rectangle the water can't spread beyond. |
| `id` | string | no | Water id; derived from the name if omitted. |

## updateWaterBody

Changes a lake/pond: its level (raise it to flood more, lower it to shrink), seed point, name, color or limiting area.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `waterId` | string | yes | Water body id. |
| `level` | number | no | New surface height (meters). |
| `x` | number | no | New seed x. |
| `z` | number | no | New seed z. |
| `name` | string | no | New name. |
| `color` | string|null | no | "#rrggbb", or null for the default blue. |
| `area` | object|null | no | { x, z, width, depth } limit, or null for none. |

## removeWaterBody

Removes a lake/pond.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `waterId` | string | yes | Water body id. |

# 3D maps: objects

## placeObject3D

Places an object on a 3D terrain at (x, z) in meters; it stands on the ground (+ elevation). 3D objects show their model, 2D objects an upright billboard of their sprite.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `objectId` | string | yes | Id of an object in the project catalog. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Id of a layer of that map. |
| `x` | number | yes | World x in meters, 0 to the terrain width. |
| `z` | number | yes | World z in meters, 0 to the terrain depth. |
| `elevation` | number | no | Meters above the ground (default 0). |
| `rotation` | number | no | Yaw in degrees, counter-clockwise seen from above (default 0). |
| `scale` | number | no | Uniform scale (default 1). |
| `spriteId` | string | no | 2D objects: which sprite the billboard shows (default sprite if omitted). |
| `id` | string | no | Placement id; derived from the object id if omitted. |

## updatePlacement3D

Moves, rotates, scales or re-layers a placed object (only the given fields change).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `placementId` | string | yes | Placement id. |
| `x` | number | no | New x (meters). |
| `z` | number | no | New z (meters). |
| `elevation` | number | no | Meters above the ground. |
| `rotation` | number | no | Yaw in degrees. |
| `scale` | number | no | Uniform scale. |
| `layerId` | string | no | Move to another layer. |
| `spriteId` | string|null | no | 2D objects: sprite to show, or null for the default. |

## removePlacements3D

Removes placed objects by id.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `placementIds` | array | yes | Array of placement ids. |

## duplicatePlacements3D

Copies placed objects, offset by (dx, dz) meters (default 2 m along x).

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `placementIds` | array | yes | Array of placement ids. |
| `dx` | number | no | Offset along x (meters, default 2). |
| `dz` | number | no | Offset along z (meters, default 0). |

## scatterObjects3D

Places many copies of an object at random spots that pass the filters (height, slope, dominant terrain layer, spacing, water) — forests, rocks, bushes. Deterministic for a given seed.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mapId` | string | yes | Id of the map to edit. |
| `objectId` | string | yes | Id of an object in the project catalog. |
| `layerId` | string | yes | Id of a layer of that map. |
| `count` | integer | yes | How many to place (fewer if the filters leave too little room). |
| `seed` | integer | no | Random seed (default 1). |
| `area` | object | no | { x, z, width, depth } world rectangle (default: the whole terrain). |
| `circle` | object | no | { x, z, radius } circular area around a point, in meters. |
| `minHeight` | number | no | Skip terrain lower than this (meters). |
| `maxHeight` | number | no | Skip terrain higher than this (meters). |
| `maxSlope` | number | no | Skip slopes steeper than this (degrees). |
| `onTerrainLayerId` | string | no | Only where this terrain layer dominates (e.g. trees on grass). |
| `water` | string | no | "avoid" (default): dry land only. "only": under water only (sea and lakes) — fish, seaweed, shells. "any": both. |
| `floatInWater` | boolean | no | With water "only": random heights between the bottom and the surface (fish) instead of on the bottom. |
| `avoidWater` | boolean | no | Deprecated: false = water "any". |
| `minDistance` | number | no | Minimum spacing in meters from each other and from existing placements. |
| `avoidOtherObjects` | boolean | no | False: spacing only considers existing copies of this object (default true). |
| `scaleMin` | number | no | Random scale range min (default 1). |
| `scaleMax` | number | no | Random scale range max (default scaleMin). |
| `randomRotation` | boolean | no | Random yaw (default true). |
| `spriteId` | string | no | 2D objects: sprite shown by the billboards. |
